uk-visa-photo-requirements.title: UK Visa Photos: Application Centres, ID Check App & Uploads
uk-visa-photo-requirements.description: Find out how your UK visa route collects your photograph, when the ID Check app applies, and why passport photo sizes are not a universal visa requirement.
uk-visa-photo-requirements.content:
Start with your visa application instructions

UK visa applications do not all use one downloadable photo format. GOV.UK explains that applicants usually provide a photograph and fingerprints at a visa application centre. Some applicants are offered the UK Immigration: ID Check app instead. Your application tells you which process applies.

Source reviewed 6 October 2026: GOV.UK: proving your identity.

If your application offers the ID Check app

Follow the app’s capture instructions. Its identity process includes taking a facial photograph; buying a processed image does not replace that process. Check device eligibility and the steps in the official ID Check app guide.

If you are asked to upload or bring a separate photo

Use the instructions supplied for your route or appointment. Confirm dimensions, file limits, background, and whether editing is permitted. This guide does not establish a universal UK visa pixel size or print size. Passport guidance alone is not proof that those specifications apply to every visa.

Where PixPassVisa can help

Our photo checker provides automated feedback. It cannot complete UKVI identity verification or promise visa acceptance. The UK passport tool serves a different document; use it only when its settings match your actual instructions.

Checks and previews are free. Processed downloads are paid at the price shown before checkout. Do not purchase a download if your application requires a live photo or an appointment instead.

Before submitting

  • Identify your visa route and the identity process offered in your application.
  • Keep the original photograph and follow any restrictions on editing.
  • Use the application’s own instructions if they differ from a third-party guide.

australia-visa-photo-requirements-size-s.title: Australia Visa Photos: Check Your ImmiAccount Instructions
australia-visa-photo-requirements-size-s.description: Check photo requests for your Australian visa application. Understand the difference between visa instructions, passport photos, free checks and paid downloads.
australia-visa-photo-requirements-size-s.content:
Use the instructions for your visa application

Start with the documents requested for your application in ImmiAccount and any instructions from the office handling your case. See Home Affairs: applying online in ImmiAccount. We have not verified a single photograph size, file limit, or editing policy that applies to every Australian visa subclass.

Visa, passport, and citizenship photos are different workflows

The Australian Passport Office photo guidance concerns passports. It must not automatically be used as a visa specification. Citizenship has its own Home Affairs photo instructions, including an unedited-image requirement. A passport preset does not certify a visa or citizenship photo.

What to confirm before preparing a file

  • Your visa subclass and whether a separate photograph is requested.
  • Whether the photo is uploaded, printed, or captured at an appointment.
  • The required dimensions, format, file size, photo age, and background.
  • Whether cropping, compression, or background changes are allowed.

If instructions are unclear, ask the application office before editing or buying a photo. We cannot substantiate claims that a tiny size difference always causes automatic rejection, or that background replacement is permitted for all visa applications.

What this service currently offers

PixPassVisa provides free automated checks and previews. Processed downloads require a one-time payment at the price shown before checkout. A complete processed download is not advertised here as free.

The country-editor configuration currently contains an Australian passport preset, not a separate Australian visa preset. See Australia visa guidance and preset limitations. Use the Australian passport checker for the passport workflow only, and check the official requirements before submitting.

Sources and local tool configuration reviewed 6 October 2026. Application-specific visa measurements remain unverified. Automated feedback and paid downloads do not guarantee government acceptance.
